source.coverObserved: PDF front cover carries 2009 wrapper copy; cover is not treated as an interior printed folio.
source.editionStatus: Title-page wording transcribed from visible pixels; exact printing/scan provenance is not independently established.

method.sourceFirstDenominator: The 223 main monster-entry headings were enumerated from the original printed Alphabetical Table of Contents (pp.3-4) before reconciliation to monsters.json. Labels were assisted by the source text layer and corrected against rendered source pixels. This is a heading count, not a count of complete creature profiles. It is not a semantic review count.
method.visualInspection: Verified source SHA-256; rendered all 114 PDF pages at 1.25x into private PNGs and inspected all 19 contact sheets. Full-page pixel views additionally inspected PDF pp.4-7 and 107-110; index pp.107-110 also rendered at 2x. Full-page renders remain under /workspace/vault-audit-private/mm/.
method.textLayer: PyMuPDF text extraction was used only as a locator/candidate screen; empty, misread or OCR-only text does not establish source absence or completeness.
method.pageMapping: The inherited monsters.json map says printed page N maps to PDF page N+1. Visual folios confirm that offset for printed pp.2-112 (PDF pp.3-113). PDF p.2 is an unnumbered title page assigned position 1 by the inherited map; a printed folio 1 was not observed. PDF p.1 is an extra cover. Per-heading printed start-page values remain locator candidates joined from existing data page fields; although index pp.106-109 were viewed at full resolution, individual index rows were not independently transcribed.
method.reconciliation: Only after source headings were enumerated, their labels and start-page locators were joined to MM records in monsters.json. Repository data is not used as the book denominator.
method.targetSearch: Inspected tools/assemble.mjs, README.md and dist/data.json. The assembler does not load monsters.json; README explicitly says monster dependencies do not create a searchable monster catalogue.

classificationDefinitions.present-findable: A complete source item is present and discoverable in the assembled app; none of the MM bestiary headings met this condition.
classificationDefinitions.present-unfindable: A corresponding record exists in monsters.json but is not present in the assembled searchable data.
classificationDefinitions.incomplete: A corresponding repository record is a locator, family locator or short description, and/or has statistics pending visual verification; it does not represent a complete source entry.
classificationDefinitions.citation-only: A source page is referenced by an assembled item without a complete source entry being represented.
classificationDefinitions.absent: A source heading was visually confirmed in the book and has no matching MM entry in monsters.json within the checked heading scope.
classificationDefinitions.excluded: The whole monster-catalogue content is explicitly outside the current assembled app's searchable data scope.
classificationDefinitions.unassessable: The current evidence does not establish item-level content or completeness.
